description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

The Basic Details package provides a range of data to round out the company profile, including business descriptions (in a range of languages), details of the advisers to the company, head office and registered office addresses, and the number of employees, alongside details of the IPO, the company’s legal structure, and details of the primary listing of their shares.
The package contains the following datasets:

- Advisors
- Business Description
- Company Address
- Company-Level Basic Details
- Employee Number
- Preferred Stock Details
- Preferred Stock Payment Schedule
- Preferred Stock Redemption Schedule
- Security-Level Basic Details

Most recent data supported.
